wa_narrow_arrow_and_further_right_narrow.notes: SCOPE: LINK-UP (catalog defect, owner call). Mountain Project's page (shared 2023, FA "Many") strings together pitches of rows we already hold: P1 starts on Godzilla P1 (wa_godzilla) and traverses right to the perch atop Natural Log Cabin (wa_natural_log_cabin); P2 goes to the top-of-P2 anchor of Narrow Arrow Direct (wa_narrow_arrow_direct); P3 is Narrow Arrow Direct's P3; P4 is The Cleft (stored as an alt_name on wa_narrow_arrow_direct) and an offwidth to the Narrow Arrow summit; P5 is Higher Learning (wa_higher_learning, 120 ft, 5.10a); P6 is Voyage of the Majestic Glass-eyed Tuna (wa_voyage_of_the_majestic_glass_eyed_tuna), or the bolted direct start of Path of Righteousness (wa_path_of_righteousness). It has no pitch of its own. Neither the Index guide's Lower Town Wall list (rakkup) nor theCrag's Lower Town Walls sector lists it, so it is an MP-only link-up. Stored 5.10d / 6 pitches / 137 m all match MP (450 ft), but nothing is locked on a link-up; only the wrong-manager access is proposed. MP's rack (single source, not proposed): doubles micro to #3, one #5, optional #4, triples around 0.2 for P3. CONTEXT for wa_narrow_arrow_direct (read-only): theCrag's sector list shows Narrow Arrow Direct as 3 pitches (5.12c, 5.10d, 5.10b) and MP's Indirect page refers to NAD's P2 and P3 anchors, while that row stores 2 pitches and 30 m; worth a look in a later batch. No safety warning on the page beyond a critical cam placement protecting the follower high on P1.
